owner: Hypercurve exact SVG interchange and finite path projection; CSGRS SVG adapter transports native failures
review: HCP3 native geometry reader/writer remain the single codec for those eight families. Only paths containing retained authored restrictions select HCP4; authored output stays version 3 and both versions remain readable.

HCP4 definitions appear before their users. Wrong, forward, cyclic and wrong-kind references fail. Native source restrictions cannot reference other restrictions. All records are validated, including unused records.

A root is reconstructed from its original polynomial and isolator with strict root counting. A projective image is reconstructed over its referenced selected parameter with a nonzero-denominator check. Cached root counts, point coordinates and success flags are not serialized.

Local pointer keys memoize live immutable source/root storage during writing; numeric references are assigned in traversal order and no addresses are serialized. The reader shares the checked objects. Independent allocations need not be merged for correctness.

Native source, original parameter range and traversal define the retained image. Reading calls existing strict range, restriction, reversal and path-connectivity authorities; it creates no second geometry kernel.

Finite path projection now consumes existing certified restricted_source_spans through the existing fragment sampler. Source selection remains authoritative, and display points never feed replay or exact incidence. The existing SVG maximum segment count is enforced before returning a complete document.

SvgError::Exact retains the kernel error. The root adapter maps it into its existing IoError::Construction/ValidationError::ExactCurve path, preserving invalid, unsupported, undecided and budget categories.

Both original export and finite-projection blockers were reproduced against the unchanged dca6233549 library. The first prototype compile errors, subsequent six projection failures and strict-lint failure remain retained; no hard fixture or existing test was weakened.
demonstrated_prototype: Nine replay/projection tests, twenty existing SVG tests, four scalar-certificate SVG tests, and sixteen root adapter/export tests passed. Fresh process reload consumes its output in further exact operations. Final qualification remains in progress after stronger reference/pole assertions and the parity helper fix.
limits: Only authored-source restrictions with Bezier scalar/algebraic parameter definitions are encoded; general generated carriers and jointly selected fibers remain open.
Filled-region export still uses finite projection. The format has per-path sharing, not cross-path or joint scalar-DAG serialization.
Existing byte, segment, scalar and predicate limits do not constitute total arithmetic, coefficient growth, memory or cooperative cancellation bounds.
The tight-tolerance retry fixture completed within its external 300-second envelope, but no controlled performance improvement is claimed.
Full repository pre-push qualification for this new increment and published-package delivery remain open.
